## Verdict: PASS

N-1 and N-2 are FIXED and PINNED, and each pin is red on its before-image. N-3 and N-4 are FIXED as wording, with the
text as the deliverable. N-5's tier argv half stays REPORTED, for a confirmed ownership reason. N-8 stays DEFERRED to
M4 by J423, and nothing was built for it. Every gate is green. The refusal census did not rise (0 → 0 lawful). The
check found no blocker. It found three new notes (N-9 – N-11): two are M4 hardening rows, and one is a session
attribution note.

scratch `census.mts` under `tsx`) on the built mirror. The after-image is the tree's runner. The before-image is the
same runner with K21, which is the before runner's `units()` line. On the tree, and identically on the mirror, the
counts are: PR 0 manifest problems, 52 units, 0 jobs failed before a unit, 1 pending, 2 not built, verdict pass;
nightly and milestone 0 problems, 0 units, 0 failed before, 1 pending, 9 not built. Every job's (name, status,
outcome) is equal before and after. Lawful-input refusals were 0 and are still 0, so the census did not rise. The
seat's first census on the unbuilt mirror showed B-FUZZ "the harness failed to load: Cannot find module …
@plat/testkit/dist/index.js". That was an artefact of the mirror before its `build`, and is the typed outcome
C-0241 (3) gives. The tree is unaffected.

as follows. Neither is a blocker, because neither lies on an honest code path or yields a wrong result for honest

* **N-11.** The session attribution note on the whole-wave `landed:verify` (above). It goes to the session before the
